svg.title: KikuchiCUDA crystal periodic table
svg.desc: Nickel and aluminium are green because crystal files are included in the repository. Other elements are gray because no crystal file has been added for them yet.
svg.text: Green = crystal file created · Gray = no crystal file in this repository yet
Ni and Al JARVIS-DFT examples are included; each JSON records its source and DWF fallback.
